name: reclip
description: Download videos from almost any website. Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
one_liner: A simple website you host yourself that downloads videos or audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and 1000+ other sites with one paste-and-click.
buyer: A hobbyist content creator who wants to archive or repurpose clips for personal use — not really a paying business customer.
business_use_cases: A creator archives their own posted clips across platforms into one local library for editing and reuse.
A researcher saves publicly available video clips referenced in a project for offline analysis.
A small media team batch-downloads reference clips for internal review before licensing the full footage properly.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted convenience version for a small fee, though this directly overlaps with the free self-hosted option and legal/ToS risk.

steal_this: Honestly, this is a personal-use utility, not a business. The most 'buildable' weekend project is just self-hosting it for your own archive — don't build a public paid service around downloading other platforms' content.
